pre_freeze_review.synthesis: Synthesis (workflow wf_667d7775, 28 agents, 2026-09-10 01:38 UTC): fix then freeze. The design core - one exact-count clause on the five pinned real families, 0015's bar verbatim, three reproductions at 0.005, a two-sided null at 0.01 run first, hash-bound extension arrays, a measured leakage scan, recomputed fingerprints and readings - is sound and every confirmed finding was already in the working tree and exercised by a green 71-case gate. Three items had to land before the freeze: (1) the reader consulted the NOT RUN marker only when the artifact was absent, while the runner files NOT RUN after writing an in-progress artifact, so a failed null or a reproduction drift would have read as a resumable VOID instead of NOT RUN - fixed in the reader template (the marker now takes precedence; one mutation case added, 72 in the gate); (2) this review record was incomplete and the log's question, why_now and cost anchors still carried the pre-review clause, an overclaim and a misattributed peak - restated here; (3) the evidence-page renderer printed the eight-family mixture against 5433 as the clause - rewritten to the real-family count against 3402 with the mixture as a flag. Five minor wording items adopted (the least-compressible subset described in words, the sealed_set_disclosure's last clause, the runner's docstring and memory comment, the RFC copyright statement in EXT_SOURCES.md verified by grep, a CORRECTIONS line on 0015-0017's sealed ordinals). Declined: reverting to the mixture clause with a real-family flag (the verifier of the blocker preferred that smaller fix because the smoke had shown the real families scoring below the synthetic ones; the record keeps the re-scope because it is the harder clause and the only one that can license the claim the question makes, and choosing the harder clause after that disclosure is the conservative direction); replacing hexdump or rebuilding the smoke corpus on a disjoint seed; renaming the high_entropy subset key; adding smoke/invocation to the chain's sealed fields (would fail every earlier entry); a reader cross-check of committed checkpoint files; a mechanical relaunch bound. Frozen after these landed and the full suite read 387/387.
